text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President held talks with justice minister on reforms.
- Tunisian foreign affairs minister met in Paris with his French counterpart to discuss bilateral and regional issues.
- Interior minister held talks with Libyan public order minister on close relations between the two countries.
- Tripoli grateful to Tunisia for hosting its reconciliation talks with Mauritania earlier this month.
- President gave an interview to Argentinian newspaper.
- New air link between Tunisian island of Jerba and Istanbul to start on March 30.
- Ali Belgaied elected president of the Organisation for the Defense of Consumers.
- Tunisian health minister says Tunisia to send medical delegation to pilgrimage to assure good health conditions.
